causal_chain.text: The missing builder produced 13 RED cases. Final GREEN recorded 14 cases, adding a swapped-UUIDs-with-original-names rejection. The actual cached parser rejects both original commands and fully parses both repaired commands without executing them.

symptom.text: The first creative-mode command for the control player did not establish success, so the remaining equipment and position sequence stopped. The server log later recorded a player-only target parser rejection.

trigger_conditions.text: The registered gamemode command supplied a bare synthetic player UUID as the target of a player-only argument.

root_cause.text: The real cached Minecraft 1.20.1 GameModeCommand and EntityArgument player-only parser rejects both original bare UUID targets with ERROR_ONLY_PLAYERS_ALLOWED. The fixed command parses an exact single outer entity UUID and applies nested gamemode to the source itself.

repair.text: An inert fixture builder validates the exact two approved name, UUID and role bindings, then returns execute-as-exact-UUID commands with gamemode creative @s. It accepts no arbitrary command text, mode, selector, new name or UUID and performs no I/O or execution.

lesson.text: Exercise fixed registered command text with the exact Minecraft parser. A player UUID identifies a player but does not make every parser argument accept its bare textual form.

limitations: Original operation receipt remains completed=true, outcome=UNKNOWN, success=null and command_result=0. The parser-error log does not rewrite that receipt.
No later equipment, native staff use or multiplayer acceptance is inferred.
The parser harness deliberately does not initialize full game registries, Bootstrap, a server or world, and it never executes a command; this is an offline parse contract.

symptom.text: The control Gradle build reported that its daemon disappeared and the registered process result was FAIL.

trigger_conditions.text: The disappearance was observed during the bounded staff batch with concurrent server and two client roles. Post-run memory counters were collected only after the processes closed.

root_cause.reason: No contemporaneous PID-attributed kill or crash evidence is retained. Cumulative post-run OOM and OOM-kill counters cannot identify which process died or establish causation.

repair.text: A bounded resource diagnosis and preparation proposal is retained as an offline proposal only. It does not attribute the historical daemon disappearance or establish a repaired runtime.

lesson.text: Preserve process failure and collect time-bounded, process-attributed evidence before attributing a disappearance to memory pressure. A later cumulative counter is insufficient.

limitations: Post-run memory.events recorded oom=17 and oom_kill=7; these are cumulative context with no attributable batch baseline or process identity.
Heap reduction or serialized preparation would be a proposed mitigation, not proof of the original cause.

causal_chain.text: Ten baseline failures against isolated original code plus privacy, original-payload-versus-summary-hash and HTTP-200-error-envelope RED controls preceded the final 110 passing focused cases. The Java 17 transport peer was compiled and exercised by the offline tests.

symptom.text: The invoker paired baseline stopped with HTTP 409 and no completed invoker client capture.

trigger_conditions.text: A retained server-before observation exists for the exact invoker UUID at server tick 6018. The pair route next calls the receiving client handshake and capture.

root_cause.reason: The original client-facing exception retained only HTTP 409. The evidence narrows the failure to client handshake or capture but does not preserve the precise rejection reason; timeout, readiness, identity or other causes cannot be selected.

repair.text: The observer and client now exchange a strict bounded signed error envelope with allowlisted exception categories. The client verifies nonce-bound HMAC before retaining the error, request identity hashes and a bounded validated handshake summary. Rejections remain ERROR/UNKNOWN with retry_allowed=false. This improves future diagnostic retention without assigning a cause to the old 409.

lesson.text: Retain bounded authenticated observer error details while preserving nonce/signature checks and unknown mutation outcomes. Improved diagnostics must not be presented as a fix for an unproven historical cause.

limitations: No causal link to the control daemon disappearance is established.
No automatic retry or native staff gesture is inferred from the failed baseline.
